notes.title: New Update Live #7 - Character Customization
notes.content:
Character Customization is Here!

\Hello Everyone!\

First of all, we sincerely thank all our players for their patience.
A brand new era begins in the Football Life Simulator universe: Character Customization is now live!
Now you can be the star not only on the field, but in style as well.

\🎨 What Kind of Player Are You?\

With this new system, you can freely customize your character’s:

Hair style and color

Skin tone

Face shape and beard

Eye color

...and much more!

Become a charismatic on-field leader or a street-styled football icon — the choice is yours!


\💾 Compatible with Existing Saves\

The character customization system works seamlessly with your existing save files.


\🔓 How to Access It?\

If you're using an old save, you’ll be automatically directed to the character screen after a quick prompt when entering the game.

New players will access this feature during the initial character creation screen.


\🚀 More to Come!\

This first version brings you the core customization options. Soon, we’ll be adding:

Tattoos

Clothing variations

Unique hairstyles

And... a wardrobe system that allows you to change your look mid-career!


\🛠️ A Note:\

The Open World update is progressing at full speed.
For those curious, we’ve shared visual updates on our Trello board!


\🔮 What’s Next?\

Here’s what we’re working on next:

Champions League

Open World

Full match gameplay

Position selection

Unlocking all restricted features in the game

Thank you again for your patience, support, and dedication.
Football Life Simulator is growing with you. ❤️

— The FLS Team

notes.title: FLS - HOTFIX
notes.content:
Thank You for Your Feedback!
 We sincerely thank everyone who shared their feedback through Steam and Discord.
 We hear you, and we’re doing our best to manage the bug fixing process as quickly as possible.

We apologize for the recent delays. Throughout this process, we encountered unexpected technical issues, and solving them took a bit more time than we anticipated.
 However, we’re working diligently to ensure everything progresses in a more stable and reliable way.

FLS is getting better thanks to your support! 


[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixes & Improvements
Protocol Error Fixed
 A new adjustment has been made to resolve the protocol error encountered by some players.
 We welcome any feedback from those who may still experience this issue.

Inventory System Bug
 Issues within the inventory system have been resolved. It now works more smoothly and reliably.

Casino Blackjack Freezing Issue
 The freezing problem in the casino’s blackjack game has been fixed. You can now enjoy the game without interruptions.

Bar Seating Bug
 A bug that occurred when sitting on bar stools has been resolved — your character will now sit without any issues.

Language Switch Bug
 The issue that occurred when changing the game’s language has been fixed. Language switching now works smoothly.


[hr][/hr]

Still in Testing
Character Customization
 This long-awaited feature is still in the testing phase.
 Since it affects existing save files, we’re moving forward carefully. It will be available next week!

Champions League in Testing!
 The biggest stage in European football is almost here!
 The Champions League system has entered the testing phase. Once stability and integration testing is complete, it will be fully added to the game.

notes.title: New Update Released #6
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

 A fresh update has arrived in the FLS universe! With new features and essential improvements, the game is now smoother and more enjoyable than ever.


[hr][/hr]

New Features
Training & Gym Experience System
 The old stat system has been removed — we’ve transitioned to an experience-based progression! Based on your feedback, stats no longer increase directly. Now, you earn experience through training sessions and level up to improve your player. A more realistic and balanced development system is here!


[hr][/hr]

Bug Fixes & Improvements
Top Bar Visibility Bug
 Fixed the issue where the top menu would not rise properly.

Transfer Season Bug
 Incorrect functioning of the transfer window has been resolved.

Save System Improvements
 The save system is now more stable and performs better.

Time Flow Issue
 Fixed the bug where time would stop progressing.

Map Pixelation Bug
 Visual glitches on the map have been resolved.

"Typing..." Message Issue
 The “typing” status that stayed even after conversations ended is now fixed.

Console Black Screen
 Resolved an issue where a black screen appeared when using the console feature.


[hr][/hr]

Removed Feature
Ball Toss Mechanic Removed
 To simplify gameplay and enhance the experience, the ball toss mechanic has been removed from the game.


[hr][/hr]

Optimization
Graphics and performance settings have been fine-tuned. Your PC can breathe easier now — a smoother, more stable FLS awaits!


[hr][/hr]

Still in Testing
Character Customization
 A long-awaited feature is still in the testing phase. Since it affects existing save files, we're proceeding carefully. Coming soon!

Champions League in Testing
 Europe’s biggest stage is on the way! The Champions League system is now in testing. Once stability and integration checks are complete, it will be fully added to the game.

Your feedback is very valuable to us. Don't forget to leave comments and share your suggestions. FLS is growing with you.

— FLS Team

notes.title: New Update Released #5
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

A bombshell update just dropped in the FLS universe! This time, we didn't just fix bugs — we introduced brand-new features that will change the rhythm of the game. Now, you’re in control both on the field and in daily life!

Transfer System is Live!
One of the most requested features by our community is now active after detailed testing. Your contract is now just a piece of paper! Take bold steps, receive new offers, and open a brand-new chapter in your career. Which club will you sign with? Will you carry a lower league to the top, or shine in the big clubs?

Manual Training Simulation
Don’t want to play each session manually? Now time is in your hands! You can simulate training with a single click and use your time more efficiently. Improve through gameplay or fast-track your progress!

Play Console Games
Your character no longer just sits idly at home! They turn on the console, grab the controller, and relax a bit. A little fun and chill is exactly what you need before a match!

Skip to Match Option
“Skip the idle days, just give me match day!” — If that’s your vibe, this one’s for you. Jump straight to the match without simulating the whole week!

Message Bug Fully Fixed
The previously fixed issue with messages not appearing — and only working on new saves — now works on older save files too.

Match Notification Panel
Wondering when your next match is? Wonder no more! You’ll now see upcoming matches clearly on the main screen. Get ready and don’t keep your opponent waiting!

Optimization and Bug Fixes
We’ve fine-tuned graphic and performance settings so your PC can breathe. A smoother, more stable FLS awaits! We also addressed various minor bugs.

A Note: The much-awaited character customization feature is still in testing, as it was affecting existing save files. We’re working hard to include it soon!

As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. Don’t forget to leave comments and share suggestions. FLS grows with you.

— FLS Team

notes.title: New Update Released #4
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We continue improving Football Life Simulator based on your feedback. This update introduces new nations, teams, a brand-new location, and interaction improvements to enhance your gameplay experience!

What’s New in This Update:

New Nations, New Leagues, and New Teams Added
To increase variety in the game, you can now start your career with even more national and club teams!

Manual Simulation Feature
You can now manually simulate Training and Gym mini-games. Choose to play them directly or manage your time as you like!

Massage Room Unlocked
Lost morale after a tough match? The newly opened Massage Room will help your character recover both physically and mentally.

Highlight Feature Added
Interactable objects now glow with a special highlight, making it much easier to know what you can engage with.

Fixed Message Delivery Issue
The bug where your character wasn’t receiving messages has been resolved. This fix currently applies to new save files. We're working carefully to avoid affecting your existing saves.

Improved Interview System
Questions asked to your character in interviews are now more realistic and meaningful. Feel like a star in front of the media!

A Note:
We promised the “Play Games on Console” feature last week — and it's actually ready! However, some last-minute bugs forced us to postpone it for this update. Thank you for your understanding. It will be back soon!

Coming in the Next Update

Transfer System
The long-awaited feature is ready and currently in testing. You’ll get it in the next update!

Skip to Match
For those who want to jump straight to the match instead of simulating the week — this feature is coming!

Revamped TV Gaming
We’ve resolved previous issues and are bringing back the ability to play games on TV with a brand-new system!

Your feedback means the world to us. We’ll keep evolving FLS with your support.
Thank you!

— The FLS Team

notes.title: New Update Released #3
notes.content:
Vortexia Night Club Has Arrived in FLS!
Now you're a star not just on the field, but also on the dance floor!

Our brand-new Night Club venue has joined the FLS universe.

It's the perfect spot to take a break from the intense football life, dance, socialize, and perhaps embark on a new adventure.

Additionally, some fixes and updates await you in this patch.

What's New in This Update

The Night Club venue is now accessible! Inside, new NPCs await your interaction. Various music tracks, dance animations, and mini-interactions have been added. Your character's social status will evolve based on your nightlife choices. Perhaps a scandal is on the horizon...

Fixes have been made to the week simulation feature.

Training match durations have been reduced by 20% based on feedback.

Ambient sounds have been added inside the stadium.

Coming in the Next Update

Massage Room

New Missions

Fixes to existing missions

Training-specific simulation

Playing games on TV

New Leagues

We eagerly await your feedback. More is on the way. The evolution of FLS continues with your support and comments.

— The FLS Team

notes.title: New Update #2
notes.content:
Big Update Time!

Hey everyone,

As promised, we're back with a packed update!
Major system improvements and new developments are now live!
Let’s dive into the details:

Training Match
We heard your requests for more matches in the fixture system.
Now, optional training matches have been added during the week!
These matches will affect your relationships with the press, the club president, and your teammates — and unlock new missions.

Match Day Atmosphere Updated
You will no longer teleport directly into the stadium on match day.
Instead, you’ll first gather at the facilities, travel to the stadium by team bus, go through the locker room sequence, and finally step onto the field.
This change will boost team spirit, strengthen relationships, and increase both the number of chances you get and your team’s chance to win.

Fixture Bugs Fixed

Fixed the issue where the next season wouldn't start.

Fixed the bug where the map would freeze during Season 2.

Training System Reworked

Stats will now only decrease if you skip training for 7 consecutive days.

Additionally, after completing a training session, a 7-day boost will activate to prevent stat drop.

Simulation Bugs Fixed

Several annoying weekly simulation bugs have been cleaned up.

Training sessions and events are now more stable.

Top Scorer Ranking Issue

Fixed the issue where players with fewer goals would appear above you.
Now the top spot truly belongs to you! 👑

Shot Marker Color Option Added

You can now change the color of your shot marker from the settings menu.

Optimization Improvements

We've worked on performance. FPS and the general flow of the game should now feel much smoother.

Is a New System Coming? We can't reveal too many details just yet, but let's just say: soon, you will decide how you want to play your matches.
A brand-new gameplay experience is on the way.
A little more patience — but trust us, it will be worth it!

Also, new career options are on the way. Can you guess what they might be?

IMPORTANT: Roadmap Update  
We're pulling forward some major features that were initially planned for Q2 and Q3, including the Transfer System, Champions League, and National Cup.
You won't have to wait long — these exciting additions will be coming very soon!

Coming Soon

New Career Mode: Start with the team you choose!

Character Customization: New outfits and appearance options are on the way.

New locations: Night Club, Massage Salon, President’s Office, Shopping Mall, Beach, Tattoo Parlor, Barber.

In Development

Console gaming at home (TV integration)

New Mobile Apps

Home Computer System Integration

We are building FLS together with you.
Every comment, every idea you share is part of this journey.
Keep playing, keep writing, and keep sharing your thoughts with us.

— Team FLS

notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hello FLS fans,

Today, we're excited to share with you a brand new feature and several important fixes — all part of the update plan we previously promised. Thanks to your feedback, FLS is becoming more solid with each passing day. Once again, thank you to every player who has shared feedback, whether positive or negative.

New Feature

Daily / Weekly Scheduling
You can now manage your character’s time much more freely.  
Whether you want to plan a single day or the entire week up until the next match, you can do so and simulate the flow.  
Training? Socializing? Going to the bar, the cinema, or just resting? The control is entirely yours.

Fixes and Improvements
- Fixed the issue in dribbling training where players received low scores and input delays.

- Adjusted the system for substitutes who previously couldn't get any goal chances. Now, at least one opportunity is guaranteed (though positioning skill still matters).

- Fixed the issue where the second half of the league would not start.

- Fixed the bug that prevented players from winning cups after season 4.

- Fixed the issue where players couldn't receive the "Man of the Match" award in some high-rated matches.

- Fixed the problem where players could not gain followers on social media.

- Reduced the curl effectiveness in technical training.

- Fixed the issue where light-colored boots appeared darker after customization.

- Fixed the bug where no newspaper headline appeared when the player's team was relegated.

What’s Coming in the Next Update?

Training Match  
A new internal team match system is on the way, allowing you to strengthen team relationships and play mini-matches within the game.  
Your performance in these matches will unlock new mechanics and enhance social dynamics.

New Career Path Option  
Start from the lowest league and climb to the top, or jump right into your favorite team. The choice will be yours.

Manual Scheduling  
If you only want to simulate a specific training session without skipping the whole day, precise solutions are coming.

Night Club (New Location!)  
VIP areas, tipping dancers, and the heart of nightlife will come to life in this new interactive location.  
A social space full of surprises is on the way.

Your feedback is always incredibly valuable to us.  
We are building FLS together — and we continue to read all your comments, suggestions, and even criticisms.

Stay tuned. New content is coming soon!

notes.title: Fixture System Update
notes.content:
🎉 Hello everyone!

With the latest update, we’ve fixed a frustrating issue in the fixture system where some wins were incorrectly marked as losses — and vice versa. From now on, your hard-earned victories will be counted properly! 🛠️⚽️

Huge thanks to everyone in the community who helped spot this and continues to support us. 💚
With your feedback, we’re improving FLS day by day. Stay tuned — the next update isn’t far away. 🚀

notes.title: 2-Week Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Not even two full days have passed since FLS launched, and we want to give a massive thank you to every single player for all the understanding, patience, and support you've shown us.

We're here to share the two-week roadmap for FLS. This plan is shaped directly by your feedback, suggestions, and requests. In just the past two days, we've already pushed two hotfixes to address major issues as quickly as possible. But if you're still experiencing bugs, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

Week One

New Fixture System
We're already working on adjusting the fixture system so that matches are played every three in-game days. Our goal is to complete testing this week and integrate the update quickly to improve your overall experience.

Week Two

Daily/Weekly Scheduling

You'll soon be able to plan out your day freely:
Shoot practice in the morning, relax at noon, hit the bar in the evening... Whether it's just a day or your entire week leading up to a match, you’ll be able to simulate as you wish.

The performance scores you receive during simulation will depend on how well you've done in previous trainings.

And for players who don’t want to simulate the whole day, we’re working on adding simulation options to each individual activity zone.

Week Two #2

Match System Improvements

We’ve already reduced the chance of starting as a substitute in our last update, making it easier to get time on the pitch. In addition, we’re working on adjustments so that when you come off the bench, you’ll have more chances to get involved in key plays.

Bonus
After these core improvements, we’re planning to introduce:
- More immersive stadium interiors (locker rooms, team tunnels, etc.)
- A Night Club feature

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hello FLS fans,

Following the release, this update brings adjustments based on your feedback. Your comments mean a lot to us — please keep playing and sharing your thoughts!

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue where a task would remain on screen after a match.

Fixed incorrect language appearing in some messages.

Fixed duplicated messages in certain chats.

Fixed input lock when in bed with some NPCs.

Fixed an issue where boot customization wouldn’t save.

Fixed inability to collect some collectible cards.

Fixed an issue where certain stats would reset at the end of the day.


Improvements

Shooting mechanics improved — expect more accurate shots.

Increased curve effect on curved shots — easier to bend around obstacles.

Substitute rate reduced from 70% to 60%.

Opening and closing hours of certain locations optimized.


Optimization

Fixed an issue where some players couldn’t start a save.

Visual quality improvements.

Your feedback is gold to us. Thank you for being here — more is on the way, stay tuned! 💚

notes.title: FLS Update - New Features and Improvements!
notes.content:
Mood Drop Improvement
The mood drop has been reduced. We've also increased the speed at which you can boost your morale by showering, watching TV, and hanging out at the bar!

Hunger Drop Improvement
Reduced hunger drop. Your character's hunger level will drop more slowly, giving you more time to take a meal break.

NPC Conversation Bug Fixed
The "Protocol Error" bug in conversations with NPCs has been fixed. In our tests, no errors were encountered.

Technique 1 Training Improvement
Increased the accuracy of the shot spin in Technique 1 training.

Shot Bar Improvement
Slowed down the filling speed of the shot bar and added a new control mechanism. You will be able to control your shots with more precision!

Combo System
A combo system has been added to the gym mechanics. Now you can customize your workouts even more and perform combos!

We are looking forward to your feedback! Have more fun with the new features!

notes.content:
Hello again from FLS TV!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174689/502b1c1e4e44e2bf217edd0de0cde0c8f18b31ec.gif

  We had to temporarily pause our broadcasts due to disruptions and workload caused by the closure of the Discordia center by the city authorities.

 Locals say that the new transfers are quickly adapting to the city. After training sessions, players have been signing fans' jerseys (and sometimes other things) and chatting with them.
